name: CodeBit Club
description: CodeBit is Bennett University's premier programming club. We organise competitive programming contests, coding bootcamps, and collaborative open-source projects. Members regularly participate in ICPC, Codeforces rounds, and hackathons.
activities: Participation in ICPC regionals and national contests

name: AI & ML Society
description: The AI & ML Society at Bennett University fosters interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science. We run hands-on workshops, reading groups, and project sprints to help students build practical AI skills.
activities: Monthly paper reading and discussion sessions
Hands-on workshops on TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn

name: BU Robotics Club
description: BU Robotics Club brings together students passionate about robotics, embedded systems, and automation. We build bots, compete in national robotics competitions, and run workshops on Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and ROS.
activities: Arduino and Raspberry Pi training sessions

name: CipherGuard — Cybersecurity Club
description: CipherGuard is dedicated to cybersecurity education and ethical hacking. We organise Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, security workshops, and awareness campaigns. Members learn penetration testing, network security, and cryptography.
activities: Workshops on penetration testing tools (Kali Linux, Metasploit)
Guest talks from industry security professionals

name: Times Media & Journalism Club
description: Leveraging Bennett University's unique affiliation with the Times of India group, the Media & Journalism Club gives students hands-on experience in reporting, content creation, photography, and broadcast journalism.

name: E-Cell Bennett
tagline: Build your startup, shape the future
description: E-Cell Bennett nurtures the entrepreneurial spirit among students through startup boot camps, pitch competitions, mentorship from industry veterans, and networking events. We collaborate with Bennett's Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship.
activities: Mentorship sessions with founders and VCs

name: WebCraft — Web Development Club
description: WebCraft focuses on modern web development — from HTML/CSS fundamentals to React, Node.js, and full-stack frameworks. We host project sprints, UI/UX workshops, and participate in web-focused hackathons.
activities: Beginner to advanced web development workshops

name: BU Cultural Society
tagline: Where art, culture, and talent meet
description: The BU Cultural Society is the umbrella body for all cultural activities at Bennett University, overseeing dance, music, drama, and fine arts groups. We organise the annual cultural fest Udaan and semester-long events throughout the year.

name: IEEE Student Branch — Bennett
description: The IEEE Student Branch at Bennett University is affiliated with the world's largest technical professional organisation. We host technical talks, seminars, and workshops aligned with IEEE's mission to advance technology for humanity.

name: Bennett Debate Society
tagline: Argue well. Think better. Lead boldly.
description: The Bennett Debate Society cultivates critical thinking, public speaking, and argumentation skills. We participate in inter-university debating circuits including Model UN, parliamentary debate, and turncoat debates.

name: BU Sports Club
description: The BU Sports Club coordinates sports activities across cricket, football, basketball, badminton, and athletics. We organise inter-department tournaments, coaching clinics, and represent Bennett University in inter-university meets.
activities: Coaching clinics for cricket, football, and basketball

name: CloudCraft — Cloud & DevOps Club
description: CloudCraft introduces students to cloud computing, DevOps practices, and infrastructure-as-code. We collaborate with AWS and Google Cloud programs, run certification prep sessions, and organise cloud-native hackathons.
activities: AWS and GCP certification preparation workshops
Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipeline labs
Collaboration with AWS Educate and Google Cloud campus programs
